observed: Ten sequential SRAM-only hardware runs passed with FCB=0x000f0002 and every read0, foreign_read, preservation, phase_pair, half, low, high, rejected_write, overwrite and reset counter zero over 64 patterns each. The sequence was ungated base before; constant-one; constant-zero; !HADDR2; !HADDR3; four independent real !HADDR2&&!HADDR3 runs; ungated base after. Every run ended with board reset and no flash write.
causal_controls: The ungated base passed mask 0xf before and after, proving liveness and unchanged alias behavior; the same base under decoded mask 0x1 failed exactly with foreign_read=2298 and phase_pair=576. Constant-one proved all sixteen state-to-gate-to-MCU paths and the HWDATA9/HRESP local exchange preserve behavior. Constant-zero proved suppression. !HADDR2 and !HADDR3 separately proved both address inputs and their ordering. The real decoder passed four times with [offset +0,+4,+8,+c] = [state,0,0,0].
implementation: One X14Y12_SLICE5 decoder computes !HADDR2&&!HADDR3 and fans out through 37 exact clean edges to sixteen combinational 0x8888 output gates, one per retained HRDATA[15:0] lane. The composer preserves all sixteen original capture-to-feedback paths exactly and removes only each state net's MCU-sink suffix. A bounded three-route local exchange relocates HWDATA9, the HRESP/GND prefix and lane 0's gated output; original roots/leaves and all MCU sinks are preserved. Independent structural audit found zero new cross-net wire owners. Strict pack reports 555 data pips, 536 mapped, 432 block-clean, 30 relative-clean and zero legacy-absolute, predicted or unmapped selectors.
scope: Qualifies one exact L48 16-bit held-scratch composition for low-16 aligned 32-bit word reads at +0,+4,+8,+c, where +0 returns retained state and +4/+8/+c return zero, while retaining the already-qualified aligned word and halfword +0 writes, independent byte +0/+1 writes, foreign-write rejection, overwrite, one wait and GPIO4.1 synchronous reset. It does not qualify byte-read lane semantics, halfword-read lane semantics, misaligned transfers, HRDATA[31:16], higher address decoding or a full slave window, bursts, arbitrary placement/width, a generic bank generator, or integration with the public ID/counter/W1C bank.
consequence: The exact 16-bit checkpoint now has silicon-qualified word-offset isolation on both writes and low-16 aligned word reads. This remains a pinned checkpoint rather than a general 16-bit AHB register-bank claim.
next_experiment: Integrate the exact checkpoint's decoded read exits and retained write semantics into a source-generated public bank candidate, then qualify subword read-lane semantics separately before widening scope.

observed: Three SRAM-only hardware runs of the final compiler-audited 1,226-byte stub passed identically with FCB=0x000f0002. Each ran 32 distinct retained patterns and 128 post-write observation groups with sram=0, sram_zext=0, word=0, low_lane=0, upper_relation=0, zext=0, retention=0 and upper_stability=0. The independent SRAM canary 0xA53C80F1 produced LBU lanes [f1,80,3c,a5] and LHU halves [80f1,a53c]. A representative fabric observation was raw=0xffff8001 with the four LBU values and two LHU values recomposing the same raw word; raw upper AND/OR were both 0xffff and remain diagnostic only. Every run ended with board reset; no flash was written.
compiler_audit: The production runner requires _start exactly 0x20000000, no undefined symbols, a stub below the 0x20001000 mailbox, real lw/lbu/lhu/sw/sh/sb opcodes, explicit LBU offsets +0/+1/+2/+3 and aligned LHU offsets +0/+2, and rejects any emitted LHU +1/+3.
scope: Qualifies CPU-visible aligned unsigned subword reads on this exact L48 16-bit held-scratch composition: LBU +0/+1 select the retained low/high bytes, LHU +0 selects the retained 16-bit word, LBU +2/+3 and LHU +2 select the corresponding observed raw upper HRDATA lanes, every LBU/LHU zero-extends, and reads do not mutate state. It does not characterize the raw HRDATA[31:16] value (0xffff was diagnostic), misaligned halfword loads, signed loads, other offsets or a full slave window, arbitrary placement/width, a generic bank generator, or public ID/counter/W1C integration.
consequence: The exact 16-bit checkpoint's aligned CPU-visible byte and halfword read-lane behavior is now silicon-qualified without widening the raw upper-HRDATA claim. Source/public integration remains the next boundary.
next_experiment: Add fail-closed exact per-net route replay for a topology-identical structural source mirror, then rebase the held scratch to the public +4 register by changing only the write and read decoder LUT INITs.

observed: The generated structural source synthesized and Qin-packed to 101 primitives and 83 routed logical nets. Exact replay matched every primitive type and parameter, every port connection by complete driver/sink signature independent of names and bit IDs, and then transferred 101 BELs and 83 per-net ROUTING strings. Strict bitgen reported 555 data pips, 536 mapped, 432 block-clean, 30 relative-clean and zero legacy-absolute, predicted or unmapped selectors. The uncompressed and compressed outputs were byte-identical to the silicon-qualified image. Two consecutive source builds produced the same hashes.
controls: Unit negatives reject changed INIT/parameters, type, connectivity, source-only physical attributes, extra/missing cells and nets, ambiguous renamed-cell mapping, duplicate BELs, malformed routes, and missing BEL/ROUTING. The CLI accepts only registered profile names with exact source/checkpoint hashes, HSE=8, SYSCLK=10, packaged data, no ambient experimental controls, and mandatory final raw/compressed hashes; raw paths and unknown profiles fail before synthesis. Ordinary builds still use nextpnr.
scope: Qualifies deterministic source-to-route reproduction for the checkpoint-derived structural fixture under registered L48 HSE=8 and SYSCLK=10 profile mcu-ahb-bank16-read-word0. It does not qualify the structural fixture as portable canonical RTL, arbitrary source synthesis, parameter changes, another checkpoint, another device/clock/canvas, a generic register-bank generator, or public ID/counter/W1C integration.
consequence: The exact 16-bit checkpoint is no longer reproducible only by a post-route composer: a tracked source fixture now rebuilds the same qualified image through a fail-closed, hash-registered exact route-replay mechanism. Functional variants require their own registered profile and silicon evidence.
next_experiment: Compose the separately qualified +4 scratch with public ID/counter/W1C state and re-run the complete public ABI and hardware matrix.

observed: Three complete volatile-SRAM runs passed identically with FCB=0x000f0002, all sixteen error counters zero, 32 retained patterns and 160 observation groups. Qualified behavior is aligned word and halfword writes at +4, independent byte writes at +4/+5, width-appropriate rejection at the exercised +0/+6/+8/+c offsets, low-16 word reads [+0,+4,+8,+c]=[0,state,0,0], CPU-visible aligned unsigned byte/halfword lane selection and zero extension, foreign-read preservation, SRAM-churn retention, repeated reads, GPIO4.1 reset clear, and blocking of a valid +4 write while reset is asserted. Raw upper AND/OR were both 0xffff and remain diagnostic only. Every run ended with board reset; no flash command was issued.
compiler_audit: The final production runner requires _start=0x20000000, no undefined symbols, a stub below the mailbox, real lw/lbu/lhu/sw/sh/sb instructions, every exact aligned load/store offset used by the acceptance matrix, and rejects misaligned LHU offsets.
controls: The hash-bound composer admits only hwrite_word0_gate INIT 0x0044->0x0088 and read_word0 INIT 0x1111->0x2222, preserves all 101 BELs and 83 routes, and strict pack changes only six physmap-derived LUT bytes plus CRC with zero legacy-absolute, predicted or unmapped selectors. The original +0 checkpoint passed its 64-pattern oracle after the campaign. The +4 oracle run against that +0 image failed with the expected address-dependent counters, discriminating the decode change from harness/compiler liveness. Registered exact replay of the +4 structural fixture reproduces the measured raw/compressed hashes.
scope: Qualifies one exact L48 HSE=8 SYSCLK=10 held 16-bit scratch object at public byte offset +4 with the aligned and representative foreign-address semantics listed above. It does not qualify public ID/counter/W1C coexistence, the raw HRDATA[31:16] value, signed or misaligned loads, every unexercised foreign byte/halfword offset, bursts or a full slave window, arbitrary placement/width, another package/device, a generic bank generator, or complete public-bank integration.
consequence: The exact 16-bit held scratch can be rebased from +0 to the public scratch offset +4 without changing its tested state/read/reset semantics. This is a silicon-qualified public-scratch-shaped object, not a 16-bit public bank.
next_experiment: Compose this exact +4 state with the public +0 ID, +8 counter and +c W1C status; zero HRDATA[31:16]; retain one-wait/reset/non-SINGLE behavior; then run the complete public ABI, coexistence and independence matrix.
